mapper.select: SELECT * FROM announcement ORDER BY announcement_id DESC
SELECT * FROM announcement WHERE status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY published_at DESC, announcement_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcement(title, content, creation_time, creator, status, published_at, updated_at, creator_admin_id) VALUES(#{title}, #{content}, #{creationTime}, #{creator}, #{status}, #{publishedAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{creatorAdminId})
mapper.update: UPDATE announcement SET title=#{title}, content=#{content}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE announcement_id=#{announcementId}
UPDATE announcement SET status=#{status}, published_at=#{publishedAt}, updated_at=#{publishedAt} WHERE announcement_id=#{announcementId}
